title: Downtown Philadelphia Helicopter Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Get ready for the adventure of a lifetime on MyFlight Tours' downtown Philly helicopter tour! Soar high above the city and take in breathtaking views of the iconic skyline, the shimmering Delaware River, and famous landmarks like the Comcast Center. Whether it’s a special occasion or just a thrilling day out, this unforgettable experience will leave you speechless. Don’t wait — book your flight today!
